items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: he booked all the Broadway musicals at the Civic and that's how I got to play them all, you know? Because he hired me every time.

ctx.x: Who's this fellow, Fontana, you asked me?

Oh, Fontana is an old Italian immigrant from Milan, Italy, who came here and came here with an opera. I think they got stranded here. So he'd been here ever since. He was a trombone player and he wound up as a orchestra manager at Sanger, the old Sanger Theatre, you know? And then he became a personnel manager with the symphony here. Ettore Fontana. He was a real nice fellow. He was, in fact, he booked all the Broadway musicals at the Civic and that's how I got to play them all, you know? Because he hired me…
And that made him especially nice, I guess.
